Tobias posted it in #central-random yesterday (Oct 13, 9:27). He said West yard Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it to support on #8841.

One thing to check: Tobias's message didn't name Marrow Fieldworks. He was replying to a question about "Tobias's dealer account." I matched that to Marrow Fieldworks using a team note from January. It says Marrow Fieldworks was Pree's dealer account and was being handed over on Jan 5, 2026, but it doesn't name who took it. So I told Pree it should be Marrow Fieldworks and suggested she confirm with Tobias before the customer call.

I didn't find any Marrow Fieldworks ticket files I could open for her.
